root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `NikonTagsDecoder()` reads a generic text payload into `buf`, `dataLength` must stay strictly smaller than `buf.size()` so one byte remains available for the later C-string conversion in `Exiv2::toString`.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original accepts the exact-fit case `dataLength == 200` against `DataBuf buf(200)`, so the later read can fill the whole buffer and leave no spare byte for the C-string terminator. The authoritative fixed original grows the buffer to 201 and enforces the missing `dataLength < buf.size()` guard on the same stock PoC, while still executing the protected `Exiv2::toString(buf.data())` call genuinely.

nodes.description: Immediately before `Exiv2::toString(buf.data())`, the final in-bounds byte is nonzero on the vulnerable run, so the call site forwards a non-terminated buffer into the later `strlen`-based C-string conversion.
The generic Nikon text read copies exactly `buf.size()` bytes into `buf`, so the earlier zero fill leaves no in-bounds terminator once the payload overwrites the whole buffer.

edges.relation: The same `dataLength` compared by the root guard is passed unchanged as the length argument of `io_->readOrThrow(buf.data(), dataLength)`.
The same `buf.data()` pointer filled by the exact-fit text read is the pointer immediately forwarded to `Exiv2::toString(buf.data())` at the sink call site.
